description: Lowercase section, spaces around '=', a quoted value, a ';' comment, uppercase key
notes: Wine's dlls/ieframe/intshcut.c writes ICONFILE=/ICONINDEX= and reads them back as iconfile/iconindex, which only round-trips because GetPrivateProfileString folds case. That API also strips whitespace around '=' and one matched pair of quotes, and treats ';' - not '#' - as the comment character.
